terms.meta_description: Terms of Service for Pulse Flow: property and rental operations software.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of Pulse Flow (the “Service”), including pulseflow.site and app.pulseflow.site. By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms.
terms.summary_li1: Pulse Flow is operations software for property teams, not a landlord, employer, payment processor, or travel agency.
terms.summary_li2: Keep your login secure and use accurate registration details.
terms.summary_li3: Personal workspaces are free. Company billing applies to the owner when subscriptions are live.
terms.summary_li4: Do not misuse chat, upload harmful content, or process data you are not authorized to handle.
terms.summary_li5: We may update these Terms and suspend accounts that create risk.
terms.guest_intro: Stay guests request dates, receive quotes, confirm stays, chat in Support, and track deposits. Your host sets price, deposit rules, and payment instructions.
terms.guest_li1: Deposits are paid directly to your host. Send /deposit in Support with a receipt; your host confirms when received.
terms.guest_li2: Cancel at least 3 days before check-in from Stay home; within 3 days send /cancel in Support.
terms.guest_li3: Your host may cancel if a before-arrival deposit stays unpaid or unconfirmed.
terms.guest_li4: Refunds and house rules are between you and your host.
terms.owner_intro: You operate properties, invite team and guests, and are responsible for rental agreements, pricing, deposits, refunds, and local compliance.
terms.owner_li1: Send clear quotes with deposit timing and payment instructions.
terms.owner_li2: Confirm deposits in Guests or Support after checking receipts.
terms.owner_li3: Manage stays, briefings, and cancellations from Guests.
terms.owner_li4: You may cancel if a before-arrival deposit remains unpaid.
terms.employee_intro: Cleaning team members use the field app for assigned properties, jobs, and expense bills. Your company sets access and work rules.
terms.employee_li1: Work only on assigned villas and submit bills per team rules.
terms.employee_li2: Pulse Flow is not your employer; pay and supervision are with your client team.
terms.employee_li3: Guest Support chat is separate from team chat.
terms.staff_intro: Staff use the field app for tasks, jobs, team chat, and bills. Villa access and assignments are controlled by the company owner or manager.
terms.staff_li1: Complete assigned work and keep property status accurate.
terms.staff_li2: Talent directory listing is optional in Settings.
terms.staff_li3: Guest stay tools are for invited guests, not daily staff screens.
terms.s5_body1: You retain ownership of Customer Content you submit. You grant us a limited license to host and process it solely to operate and improve the Service.
terms.s5_body2: You are responsible for its legality and for complying with local privacy rules when inviting staff or storing guest/property information.
terms.s6_body: Until Stripe checkout is live, registered users receive a 3-month free period. When billing is active, company owners subscribe for gated features; referral rewards may unlock extended Full access.
terms.s7_body: The Service is provided “as is”. Pulse Flow coordinates operations; it is not legal, tax, accounting, or insurance advice. Our aggregate liability is limited to fees paid in the prior twelve months (or USD 100 if none).
terms.s8_body: We may update these Terms, suspend access, or discontinue features. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated Terms.
terms.s9_body: Questions: support@pulseflow.site. See also our Privacy Policy.

privacy.meta_description: Privacy Policy for Pulse Flow: how we handle account and operations data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Pulse Flow collects, uses, and shares information when you use pulseflow.site, app.pulseflow.site, and related services (the “Service”).
privacy.summary_li1: We collect account, operations, and technical data needed to run the Service.
privacy.summary_li2: We use data to authenticate you, deliver features, and send notifications.
privacy.summary_li3: We share data with infrastructure providers, Stripe when billing is enabled, and teammates according to role.
privacy.summary_li4: We do not sell your personal information.
privacy.guest_li1: We store date requests, quotes, stays, deposit status, briefings, and Support chat (including /deposit and /cancel).
privacy.guest_li2: Receipt images in Support are stored in cloud storage.
privacy.guest_li3: Your host and their team can see booking and Support data for your stay.
privacy.owner_li1: We process property inventory, tasks, contacts, team chat, bills, reports, guest stays, and billing metadata for your organization.
privacy.owner_li2: Guest Support messages and deposit records are visible to authorized owners and managers.
privacy.owner_li3: Stripe customer and subscription IDs are stored on the organization; card numbers are handled by Stripe.
privacy.employee_li1: We store your profile, assigned villas, job confirmations, and submitted bills.
privacy.employee_li2: Receipt photos for expenses are stored in cloud storage.
privacy.employee_li3: Guest Support chat is separate unless you are also invited as a guest.
privacy.staff_li1: We store tasks, jobs, team chat, endorsements, and submitted bills.
privacy.staff_li2: Optional talent directory listings may be visible to owners and managers searching in the app.
privacy.staff_li3: Guest stay data remains limited to hosts and that guest.
privacy.s4_body: We retain data while your organization is active and for a reasonable period afterward. We use encrypted transport and access controls.
privacy.s5_li1: Update profile and organization settings in the app
privacy.s5_li2: Manage or cancel company billing via the billing portal when available
privacy.s5_li3: Contact us to access, correct, or delete personal data where applicable
privacy.s6_body: Data may be processed outside your home country. The Service is not directed at children under 16.
privacy.s7_body: We may update this Policy and post a revised date. Continued use means you accept the updated Policy.
privacy.s8_body: Privacy questions: support@pulseflow.site. See also our Terms of Service.
